script:
"=== provider and base_url ==="
Select-String -Path "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\config.yaml" -Pattern 'provider: "custom"|base_url: "https://opencode' | Select-Object LineNumber, Line
"=== checking for bad chars around position 102091 ==="
$text = Get-Content "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\config.yaml" -Raw
"Total length: $($text.Length)"
if ($text.Length -gt 102091) {
  $snippet = $text.Substring(102080, 30)
  "Snippet: " + [BitConverter]::ToString([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($snippet))
}
